response.sql: WITH per_driver AS (SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_count * 1.0) AS value FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.qualifying_count, p.qualifying_count * 1.0 / a.value AS ratio FROM per_driver AS p CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE p.qualifying_count > 0 ORDER BY ratio DESC, p.driverId LIMIT 10;
